title: Sephiria Costumes — All 27 Roster Skins, Effects & Unlocks (1.0)
description: Sephiria costumes guide: the full 27-skin roster with opening stat effects, the 19 unlockable skins and their conditions, and what sources disagree on.
meta: Covers sephiria costumes / costume unlocks / skin effects searches.
body:
Costumes change opening stats, not just looks. Align the skin with the weapon you plan to push.

How many costumes are there?

The launch listing says over 20 costumes. The community database we cross-checked tracks the roster at v1.0.24 and counts 27 playable costumes — 8 available from the start and 19 unlocked. Older guides list 17, which predates that roster. Values were rebalanced during 1.0, so treat the numbers below as a v1.0.24 community snapshot and check the skin in your own client.

Starting costumes (8)

CostumeCommunity-recorded effect
Pink BunnyExperience gain +3% (one older source lists +4%; no trade-off listed)
Armored RabbitDefense +10, Max HP -15
Brown RabbitEvasion +12, Critical Chance -4% (older guides list +6 / -6%)
Braided Hair RabbitAttack Speed +7%, Move Speed +12%, Dash Recovery -20%
Orange RabbitDebuff Damage +14%, Defense -8
Red-Hooded RabbitListed in the roster; effect not included in the audited source
White RabbitListed in the roster; effect not included in the audited source
Wing-Eared RabbitListed in the roster; effect not included in the audited source

Unlockable costumes (19) and what unlocks them

Conditions confirmed by two independent guides

CostumeUnlock
Red-Clothed CatRaise Fire damage to 50
FrogRaise Lightning damage to 50
Red FoxAcquire 10 or more Tablets in a single adventure
White WolfDefeat the Pillager Leader, Rataka, five or more times
Wizard BunnyDefeat 50 enemies with magic
SkeletonTake 333 cumulative damage in a single run
Wingless BatComplete the Blood Donation event (Manok / the Iron Maiden) five times across runs
Adventurer RabbitOwn Dungreed on the same Steam account — the Steam guide author marks this one as uncertain

Conditions the sources disagree on

CostumeReported unlocks
MoleDefeat 300 fanatic moles (two guides) or defeat the first boss (wiki) — verify in your client

Listed in the v1.0.24 roster, unlock text not in the audited source

Scholar Lizard, Ghost, Otter, Eagle, Crocodile, Deer, Fairy of Fortune, Farmer Squirrel, Turtle, Forest Cat. Other skins in the roster are also unlocked by task-based play (for example grabbing a large number of Tablets in one run).

Two different counts: the 1.0.24 patch notes mention seven costumes receiving an additional purchasable appearance, which brought the appearance records to 79. Appearances are not playable costumes — do not add the two numbers together.

How to read these effects

Every row is a trade, not a straight upgrade: Armored Rabbit buys defence with Max HP, Orange Rabbit buys debuff damage with defence. Pick the costume that props up the stat your build is worst at, and see characters for what else changes between runs.
